title: The Queue That Felt Longer
title_ja: 長く感じられた待ち時間
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Mina worked at a bakery on Saturday mornings.
sentences.ja: ミナは土曜日の朝にパン屋で働いていた。

sentences.en: Customers sometimes waited outside when the shop became crowded.
sentences.ja: 店が混むと客は外で待つことがあった。

sentences.en: She noticed that some people seemed impatient even during short waits.
sentences.ja: 短い待ち時間でもいらいらしている人がいると気づいた。

sentences.en: However, others remained calm during much longer waits.
sentences.ja: しかしもっと長く待っても落ち着いている人もいた。

sentences.en: One morning, the owner put a notice near the entrance.
sentences.ja: ある朝、店主は入口の近くに掲示を置いた。

sentences.en: It explained that fresh bread would be ready in ten minutes.
sentences.ja: 焼きたてのパンが10分で用意できると説明していた。

sentences.en: Several customers read the notice before joining the line.
sentences.ja: 何人かの客は列に並ぶ前に掲示を読んだ。

sentences.en: They could then decide whether to wait or return later.
sentences.ja: それで待つか後で戻るか決められた。

sentences.en: Mina asked two customers about their experience after they received their bread.
sentences.ja: ミナはパンを受け取った二人の客に感想を尋ねた。

sentences.en: Both had waited for nearly the same amount of time.
sentences.ja: 二人ともほぼ同じ時間待っていた。

sentences.en: One said that knowing the expected waiting time had helped.
sentences.ja: 一人は予想される待ち時間が分かって助かったと言った。

sentences.en: The other said that talking with a friend had made waiting pleasant.
sentences.ja: もう一人は友人と話すことで待つ時間が楽しくなったと言った。

sentences.en: Mina understood that the notice was only one possible explanation.
sentences.ja: ミナは掲示は考えられる説明の一つにすぎないと理解した。

sentences.en: She had not collected enough information to compare all customers fairly.
sentences.ja: すべての客を公平に比較する十分な情報を集めていなかった。

sentences.en: Instead, she suggested keeping the notice and asking more people later.
sentences.ja: その代わり掲示を残して後でさらに多くの人に尋ねることを提案した。

sentences.en: The owner agreed to try the change for another week.
sentences.ja: 店主はもう1週間変更を試すことに同意した。

sentences.en: The experience made Mina interested in how people judge time.
sentences.ja: その経験からミナは人が時間をどう判断するかに興味を持った。

sentences.en: A clock can measure the length of a wait.
sentences.ja: 時計は待ち時間の長さを測れる。

sentences.en: Yet a person's experience of waiting may depend on other things.
sentences.ja: しかし待つ経験はほかのことにも左右され得る。

sentences.en: Mina learned to ask about feelings as well as numbers.
sentences.ja: ミナは数字だけでなく気持ちについても尋ねることを学んだ。

vocabulary.definition: a shop that makes or sells bread
a reason that makes something clear

questions.prompt: What did Mina notice about waiting customers?
options: Some became impatient even during short waits.
They always waited the same time.
questions.explanation_ja: 短い待ち時間でもいらいらする人がいた。

options: When fresh bread would be ready.
questions.explanation_ja: 焼き上がりの時刻を知らせた。

questions.prompt: How did the notice help customers?
options: They could choose whether to wait or return.
They could buy bread without paying.
They no longer needed to stand in line.
They could change the bread recipe.
questions.explanation_ja: 待つか戻るか判断できた。

questions.prompt: What was similar for the two customers?
options: The number of friends with them.
The type of notice they wrote.
Their reasons for visiting the shop.
The amount of time they had waited.
questions.explanation_ja: ほぼ同じ時間待っていた。

questions.prompt: What made waiting pleasant for one customer?
Why did Mina want to ask more people?
options: She had forgotten where the notice was.
The owner refused to keep the notice.
Two customers were not enough for a fair comparison.
All customers had given identical answers.
questions.explanation_ja: 情報が十分でなかった。

questions.prompt: What is different from measured waiting time?
options: How a person experiences the wait.
The number shown on a clock.
questions.explanation_ja: 人が待ち時間をどう感じるか。

options: People's experiences of time may differ even when the clock shows similar waits.
Clocks are unable to measure time.
questions.explanation_ja: 時間の感じ方は同じとは限らない。

grammar.explanation_ja: evenは意外な状況を強調する。

grammar.focus: whether to wait or return later
grammar.explanation_ja: whether toは二つの行動の選択を表す。
過去完了は発言以前の出来事を示す。

discourse.role_ja: 掲示を読んだ後の行動。
結論を急がず別の行動を選ぶ。
時計の測定と主観的な体験を対比。

paraphrases.source: She noticed that some people seemed impatient even during short waits.
paraphrases.rewrite: She saw that a brief wait could still make some customers restless.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 短時間でも落ち着かない客がいた。

paraphrases.source: They could then decide whether to wait or return later.
paraphrases.rewrite: They could choose between waiting and coming back later.

paraphrases.source: One said that knowing the expected waiting time had helped.
paraphrases.rewrite: One customer found the information about the wait useful.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 待ち時間の情報が役立った。

paraphrases.source: Yet a person's experience of waiting may depend on other things.
paraphrases.rewrite: Other factors can affect how someone feels while waiting.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 待つ感覚は別の要因にも影響される。

cloze.explanation_ja: 短時間でもいらいらした。
入口近くに掲示を置いた。
公平に比較するための情報。
